window.title: ball-plate-sim: balancing robot
app.name: ball-plate-sim
app.subtitle: Balancing robot · MuJoCo physics
caption.brain: Changing the brain ends the current attempt.
tip.throw: Tool: drag on the plate from where the ball starts; the arrow gives its direction and speed
tip.drop: Tool: click on the plate where the ball must fall, or drag from there to give it a horizontal speed (its fall is drawn)
tip.center: Ball placed motionless at the center
tip.measures: True values of the simulation, not those measured by the sensor of the robot
caption.history: Distance to the setpoint, last 10 s
state.fallen: The ball has fallen · back in {time} s
tip.push: Tool: drag from the ball; the arrow gives the push
hint.throw: Drag on the plate to throw · Elsewhere: turn
hint.drop: Click on the plate to drop · Drag: drop with a speed · Elsewhere: turn
hint.push: Drag from the ball to push · Elsewhere: turn
caption.setpoint: Where the brain must hold the ball.
tip.ball.ping_pong: Hollow, 2.7 g: the ping-pong ball of the robot
tip.ball.solid: Solid, 2.7 g: it rolls faster down a slope (J = 2/5·m·r² instead of 2/3·m·r²)
tip.latency: Time between the image of the ball and the command that follows it
caption.settings: Changing a setting ends the current attempt. All stay within what the AI brain saw in training.
caption.untrained_height: Not seen by the AI brain in training ({low} to {high} cm)
